title: Platform Ops Sync — routing / auth / quotas notes (2026-08-11)
content:
Date: 2026-08-11
Time: 09:30-10:00 PT
Meeting type: Weekly platform ops sync (ad-hoc stand-in for control plane rota)
Location: Zoom / #platform-ops Slack thread
Attendees: Asha Kapoor (owner), Miguel Ortega, Lena Zhou, Daniel Park, Priya Iyer, Kofi Mensah (15m), optional: Ruth Tan
Absentees: None noted

Purpose: quick cross-functional alignment on control plane, routing, auth, and quota workstreams + clear action owners for the coming sprint. Focused on escalations we may need to include in next SRE blameless retro.

Agenda:
- 09:30 quick status round (major changes since last week)
- 09:36 routing experiments and rollout plan
- 09:42 auth token lifecycle and audit traces
- 09:48 quotas: new policy rollout & impact analysis
- 09:54 action items and blockers

Key notes / highlights:
1) Control plane / general
- Control plane healthy overall. P50 API latency stable at 62ms, P95 at 220ms for controlplane endpoints (metrics from Datadog snapshot at 08:00). We still see a tail spike near cluster GC windows (~03:00-04:00 UTC) on two clusters.
- Miguel called out an intermittent increase in DB read latency for the metadata store (avg read latency bump from 12ms -> 40ms for ~12 mins on 2026-08-10 03:42 UTC). Incident ticket PLT-1423 opened for root-cause analysis; likely related to a slow compaction job.
- Decision: schedule a short maintenance window to test compaction throttle on non-prod next Tue 2026-08-17. If results are positive, we will roll to prod during a low-traffic window.

2) Routing (A/B routing + cost-aware fallback)
- Canary routing rollout (route-split service) progressed to 25% traffic. No regressions observed in output quality metrics (prompt-set run 2026-08-09).
- Observed an uptick in token cost variance for a small subset of requests routed to quantized variants; suspected mismatched request metadata caused suboptimal model selection.
- Action: Daniel will add stricter request metadata validation in the router (PLT-1489) and add a histogram metric for token-cost-per-request by route to make anomalies visible. Target PR by 2026-08-14.
- Note: Routing team flagged ambiguous fallback policy when both cost and latency constraints are tied; agreement to prefer latency for user-facing calls and cost for background/async workloads. Will update policy docs.

3) Auth (token lifecycle, replay protection, audits)
- Context: recent audit prep uncovered gaps in long-lived token revocation visibility. Need better trace linking between auth events and control plane decisions.
- Lena demoed a lightweight tracer span addition to the auth flow that surfaces revocation events into the controlplane trace. Prototype PR up in GitHub: github.com/redwood-inference/controlplane/pull/876 (WIP).
- Blocker: HSM integration test failures on staging — keys rotated but edge signing library throws HSM timeout (~2s threshold). Priya to coordinate with security infra owner (Ruth) and vendor support.
- Decision: temporarily extend HSM timeout to 5s in staging only to allow test runs while vendor investigation is underway. Do not extend in prod without further approval. Change tracked in PLT-1502 (internal).

4) Quotas (policy rollout + user impact)
- Summary: product requested soft quota enforcement for free-tier customers with email warnings and gentle throttling rather than hard rejects. New policy doc: Confluence link in linked_artifacts.
- Kofi ran a simulation against last 30 days of traffic: expected ~3.5% of API calls would hit soft throttle thresholds; top impacted endpoints: embedding-batch and async-generation.
- Risk: sudden shift to soft quotas may increase bursty retry traffic and push cost onto dedicated clusters. Mitigation: introduce adaptive backoff headers (Retry-After suggestion) and a per-customer burst budget.
- Action: Priya to prototype the Retry-After header and burst-budget bookkeeping in the quota service. Target demo 2026-08-18.

Open issues / blockers:
- DB compaction causing metadata read latency spikes (owner: Miguel) — needs compaction-throttle test in non-prod. Target: 2026-08-17.
- HSM integration flaky on staging (owner: Priya) — coordinate with Ruth and vendor. Short-term staging timeout bump by 2026-08-12.
- Router metadata mismatch producing cost variance (owner: Daniel) — add validation + metric by 2026-08-14.
- Quota soft-enforce simulation: need product sign-off for the adaptive backoff approach (owner: Asha) — product review scheduled 2026-08-13 11:00 PT (invite sent).

Action items (owner + due date):
- Miguel: run compaction-throttle experiment in non-prod and share results (2026-08-17) [linked ticket PLT-1423].
- Daniel: PR to add router request-metadata validation + token-cost-per-route histogram (2026-08-14) [PLT-1489].
- Priya: coordinate HSM vendor debug + bump staging timeout (2026-08-12) [PLT-1502], and prototype quota Retry-After header (2026-08-18).
- Asha: collect product feedback on soft-quota policy + confirm rollout timing (2026-08-13).
- Kofi: run an additional 7-day simulation focused on async-generation edge cases and share a short spreadsheet (2026-08-16).

Decisions made:
- Prefer latency when routing priority is ambiguous for user-facing requests; prefer cost for background jobs. Update to routing policy doc agreed.
- Temporary staging-only HSM timeout increase to unblock tests; do not change prod.

Risks to surface to SRE/Incidents queue:
- If compaction issue repeats during peak cadence, customer-visible controlplane latency may exceed SLOs. Recommend pre-warm of fallback node pool if compaction job scheduled.
- Soft quota rollout could cause higher short-term costs; provide finance and product with an immediate cost delta estimate before enabling for more than 5% traffic.

Follow-ups / next steps:
- Postmortem for the 2026-08-10 metadata latency spike assigned to Miguel (due: 2026-08-20).
- Routing policy doc updated (owner: Daniel) and pushed to Confluence; notify (#router-team) once updated.
- Auth trace PR to be reviewed and merged if no objections; add unit tests for revocation scenarios (owner: Lena).

Next meeting: 2026-08-18 09:30 PT (weekly cadence) — tentative focus on compaction experiment results and quota prototype demo.

Notes to self / rough ideas (informal):
- Consider a small 'compaction coordinator' flag to gate heavy compactions during known peak windows. Could be a simple schedule + API toggle. (Miguel)
- Add an internal dashboard tile that correlates routing decisions, model variant, and token-cost-per-request for rapid triage. (Daniel + Observability)
- We should add a short checklist for audit readiness around token revocation: list of systems, required traces, and a 15-min runbook. (Lena)

References / context links:
- PLT-1423: metadata-store latency spike (investigation)
- PLT-1489: router validation + histogram work
- PLT-1502: HSM integration / staging timeout
- Confluence: Quota policy proposal
- PR: github.com/redwood-inference/controlplane/pull/876 (auth trace prototype)

Document history:
- Drafted by Asha Kapoor on 2026-08-11 after sync; minor edits 2026-08-12 (added simulation run summary and dates).

End of notes.
